### FINAL OUTFIT RECOMMENDATION

For your upcoming business meeting in Bangalore, we are going to lean into the **"Nineties Minimalist"** trend while ensuring your look remains professional, comfortable for the 26.9°C weather, and flattering to your olive skin tone.

**The Concept:** A "Power Minimalist" ensemble in a rich, jewel-toned palette.

*   **The Hero Piece:** A **tailored cobalt blue or deep emerald green blazer** with a sleek, single-button silhouette. This provides the necessary "Business Chic" structure while incorporating your favorite jewel tones, which will make your olive skin glow.
*   **The Base:** To keep it minimalist and 90s-inspired, pair the blazer with a **crisp, high-quality white silk or cotton-blend camisole** tucked into **high-waisted, straight-leg trousers** in a neutral shade like cream or stone grey. This keeps the look balanced and breathable for Bangalore's indoor climate.
*   **Footwear:** Opt for **pointed-toe block heels** in a nude or metallic tone. They provide the professional height required for a business meeting while remaining comfortable for the entire day.
*   **Accessories:** Keep it minimal to match your style. A simple gold chain necklace and small hoop earrings will complement your skin tone beautifully without distracting from your professional presentation.
*   **Why this works for you:**
    *   **Weather-Ready:** The light silk/cotton layers are perfect for the 26°C weather, keeping you cool indoors.
    *   **Skin Tone Perfection:** Cobalt and Emerald are power colors that provide a sophisticated contrast to olive skin, ensuring you stand out confidently.
    *   **Trend-Aligned:** The clean, uncluttered lines of 90s minimalism are currently the gold standard in modern business fashion, projecting an image of efficiency and poise.
    *   **Budget & Fit:** By focusing on high-quality basics (blazer, trousers), you can easily source these items within your ₹5,000–15,000 budget at retailers like Marks & Spencer, Zara, or premium local boutiques.

**Styling Tip:** Since "fit is everything," ensure the trousers are hemmed to sit perfectly at the top of your block heels. A clean, straight silhouette will celebrate your rectangle body shape and convey an air of effortless professionalism.

You are going to look fantastic and feel incredibly prepared for your meeting! Good luck!
